tasks.label: Start ATS backend
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $listener) { $backend = Start-Process -FilePath $env:ComSpec -ArgumentList '/c','mvn spring-boot:run' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ats_backend.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ats_backend_error.log'); $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(120); do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($backend.HasExited -and -not $listener) { throw 'Maven backend exited before opening port 8080.' } } while (-not $listener -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline); if (-not $listener) { throw 'Backend did not start on port 8080 within 120 seconds.' } }
